# Twenty Release Corrections

1. Fetch origin before deciding divergence.
2. Never force-push.
3. Never reset unrelated local work.
4. Inspect worktree ownership.
5. Inspect branch-only commits.
6. Compare actual diffs, not branch names.
7. Keep ignored AI thoughts out of release.
8. Keep secrets out of commits.
9. Check large files.
10. Check GitHub limits.
11. Run `git diff --check`.
12. Run focused movie tests.
13. Run any required build/deploy test.
14. Stage by explicit path.
15. Review staged diff before commit.
16. Confirm commit is on main.
17. Re-fetch before push if integration took time.
18. Resolve conflicts from file contents, not ours/theirs shortcuts.
19. Verify remote main SHA after push.
20. Verify deployed HTTP/browser behavior after CI completes.
